## PM review — **ACCEPT**, landed

Reviewed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. PR #6139 verified against GitHub: **20 checks, 20 success/skipped, zero failures**. Marked ready and auto-merge armed (SQUASH) in the same turn.

### What made this report trustworthy

⭐ **The on-disk grep caught a no-op fix.** *"the first fix attempt was in fact a zero-hit no-op that exited 0, and only the anchored grep caught it."* That is the discipline earning its keep in real time, not as ceremony — an editor exit code is not evidence a mutation reached disk, and this run has the counterexample to prove it. Both mutation legs confirmed by grepping the exact inserted and removed text **before** any result was read.

⭐ **Numbers re-derived rather than inherited.** The card's compile population was 211; #6129 merged in between and it is now 224. The report says so explicitly and re-derives every figure. A report that had quietly reused 211 would have been wrong in a way nothing downstream would have caught.

⭐ **The annotation was shown to be load-bearing.** Removing it returns the identical `TS2322` at the identical site `235:7`; restoring it returns exit 0. And the reasoning for importing `type NavGroup` **in the same block** is the right one and worth restating: an annotation naming a type the block cannot see errors on the annotation itself, at which point TypeScript stops checking the literal underneath and the original diagnostic **disappears** — the false-green shape already recorded for `guide/theming`. A fix that silently switches off the check it was added to perform is worse than no fix.

The declared-fragment count is unmoved at 111 across all four runs, no `FRAGMENT_MARKER` was added, and `UNGATED_DOCS` / the ledger / the gate are untouched.

### Scope discipline: correct

Leaving the fence `plaintext` was right. Re-fencing `content/docs/layout` is #5867's lane, and taking it as a rider here would have merged a type fix into a fence batch — two different verification surfaces in one diff.

### The handback this seat is taking forward

⭐ **The layout group is unblocked for #5867.** This was the one `content/docs/layout` block still red for a cause of its own after PR #6129 landed the resolution half. Measured here at `Semantic phase: 224 of 224 block(s) judged, 0 failed` with the complete-example block re-fenced, so that batch is now a **pure fence change**. Recorded for the next #5867 dispatch, along with your note that a batch is in flight in `objectui-5867-b3` and may want a rebase onto this.

The site-build note (`@object-ui/plugin-gantt` / `plugin-map` unresolvable until the workspace is built, because the root `build` script excludes the site) is the fourth independent sighting of the same local build-order property today. Correctly judged environmental and correctly not filed — but four sightings is itself a signal, and this seat is tracking it rather than letting each dev rediscover it.
